frozen_claims.claim: The transformer-superiority hypothesis was not supported.
frozen_claims.basis: The frozen Phase 9 Macro-F1 difference did not have a positive 95% confidence interval excluding zero.
The frozen Phase 9 calibrated-minus-raw NLL difference was negative and its 95% confidence interval remained below zero.

frozen_claims.claim: BNS-CCB is a synthetic benchmark and is susceptible to lexical/template shortcuts.
frozen_claims.basis: The frozen TF-IDF/logistic-regression baseline achieved perfect one-shot test classification; Phase 10 output signatures show extreme label-specific separability. No test text was reopened in Phase 10.

frozen_claims.claim: The results do not establish generalisation to real NHS clinical data.
frozen_claims.basis: The confirmatory experiment evaluates a project-generated synthetic benchmark, not genuine NHS free text.
Calibrated confidence and Top-3 outputs are decision-support information only; no automatic acceptance policy is authorised.

operational_interpretation.calibrated_confidence: Descriptive model uncertainty supporting human interpretation; not a clinical-safety or billing-correctness probability.
operational_interpretation.top3_suggestions: A ranked shortlist can retain the true code for some top-1 errors and may therefore help a human reviewer consider plausible alternatives.

shortcut_audit_scope.interpretive_limit: Phase 10 cannot identify literal test-note shortcut tokens using predictions and probabilities alone.
